BindingConnectorAsUsage returns SysML::BindingConnectorAsUsage :
	UsagePrefix ( BindingKeyword UsageDeclaration? )?
	'bind' ownedRelationship += ConnectorEndMember 
	'=' ownedRelationship += ConnectorEndMember 
	DefinitionBody	
;

decision: SysML 8.2.2.13.2 states BindingConnectorAsUsage = UsagePrefix ( 'binding' UsageDeclaration )? 'bind' ownedRelationship += ConnectorEndMember '=' ownedRelationship += ConnectorEndMember UsageBody. The SysML Xtext writes UsageDeclaration? inside the group and DefinitionBody in place of UsageBody; neither is ported, since the clause names its own productions. The rule is the clause as written.
